info.title: BookingService API (Sap-atitos)
info.description: Backend API responsible for ticket purchasing, idempotency handling, and issuance (MVP-02).

get.description: Returns basic API identification and online status.
Liveness and readiness probe reporting service health.

get.summary: Retrieves all available seats for the specified event.
get.description: Returns all seats currently in 'Available' status and not reserved by a buyer for the specified event ID.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event.

200.description: List of available seats successfully retrieved.

get.summary: Checks the current availability of a specific seat in an event.
get.description: Checks whether a specific seat in an event is available, reserved or sold.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event.

parameters.name: ticketId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ticket (seat).

404.description: Event or ticket was not found.

post.summary: Reserves (locks) a specific seat for the buyer during 10 minutes.
post.description: Locks a seat for the buyer identified by email for 10 minutes. Reserving again with the same email renews the reservation. The seat must be reserved before it can be purchased.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event.

parameters.name: ticketId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ticket (seat) to reserve.

requestBody.description: Reservation request containing the buyer's full name and email.

schema.description:
Body of POST /events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/reserve. The email identifies the buyer
who will hold the seat; the purchase must be made with the same email.

200.description: Seat reserved (or reservation renewed) for the buyer.

404.description: Event or ticket not found in catalog.

409.description: Seat is already sold or reserved by another buyer.

500.description: Unhandled server error captured by global exception middleware.

post.summary: Purchases a specific seat for an event with idempotency protection.
post.description: Purchases a seat previously reserved with the same email. Requires an X-Idempotency-Key header. If the key was already used for this seat, safely returns the existing ticket (200 OK).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the event.

parameters.name: ticketId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the ticket (seat) to purchase.

parameters.name: X-Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-provided UUID in the X-Idempotency-Key header. Required to ensure safe replay.

requestBody.description: Purchase request containing attendee's full name and email.

schema.description:
Body of POST /events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/purchase. Both fields are required;
if either is missing or blank the request is rejected with 400 Bad Request.

201.description: New ticket successfully purchased and issued.

200.description: Ticket successfully returned on idempotent replay of an already processed purchase.

400.description: Request validation failed or X-Idempotency-Key header is missing/invalid.

403.description: The seat is not reserved by this buyer, or the reservation expired.

404.description: Event or ticket not found in catalog.

409.description: Seat is already sold or the idempotency key was previously used with different details.

500.description: Unhandled server error captured by global exception middleware.

ErrorResponse.description: Standardized JSON response payload for API errors.

fullName.description: Full name of the ticket purchaser (e.g., 'Jane Doe').

email.description: Valid RFC 5321 email address for order confirmation (e.g., 'jane.doe@example.com').

PurchaseTicketRequest.description:
Body of POST /events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/purchase. Both fields are required;
if either is missing or blank the request is rejected with 400 Bad Request.

fullName.description: Full name of the buyer (e.g., 'Jane Doe').

email.description: Email of the buyer; it must match the one used to purchase the seat.

ReserveSeatRequest.description:
Body of POST /events/{eventId}/tickets/{ticketId}/reserve. The email identifies the buyer
who will hold the seat; the purchase must be made with the same email.

seatNumber.description: Designated seat label within the event venue (e.g., 'A-1').

status.description: Current availability status of the seat ('Available', 'Reserved' or 'Sold').

SeatAvailabilityDto.description:
Unified DTO representing seat availability (SP-04 / ALIGN-02 / APP-01 / APP-02).
Matches the agreed seat contract with Frontend: ticketId, seatNumber, and status.

ticketId.description: Unique identifier of the reserved ticket (seat).

email.description: Email of the buyer holding the reservation.

expiresAtUtc.description: UTC time when the reservation expires and other buyers can take the seat.

SeatReservationResponse.description: Seat locked for a buyer until BookingService.Api.Contracts.SeatReservationResponse.ExpiresAtUtc.

fullName.description: Full name of the ticket holder.

email.description: Email address associated with the purchase.

purchasedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the ticket was purchased.

TicketResponse.description: Response payload returning issued ticket details.
